candidates.spoken: The SS Admiral Nakhimov sank after a collision near Novorossiysk.
It took only a freighter holding course despite warnings.
The freighter didn't slow or turn.
The liner's captain had gone to his cabin.
Both captains were sentenced to fifteen years.
The officers exchanged radio calls, but it was too late.
A pilot radioed a warning to the freighter.
The ships were in radio contact.
It started with freighter on crossing course. It ended with collision and rapid sinking.
The ships were in radio contact. Both sides assumed the collision wouldn't happen.

script.spoken: COLLISION AND RAPID SINKING. It sank within minutes, and four hundred twenty three people died. A pilot radioed a warning to the freighter. The reply was: don't worry. The freighter didn't slow or turn. The liner's captain had gone to his cabin. The officers exchanged radio calls, but it was too late. Both captains were sentenced to fifteen years.
